scope: Exact compiled artifact against synthetic real loopback API/Mongo. No staging HTTPS or production business certification; scheduler disabled to prohibit outbound background calls; service workers blocked for deterministic API routing; WhatsApp links inspected without sending messages.

rows.test: Synthetic buyer, seller and courier registered, OTP-verified and authenticated via real HTTP
Buyer and seller login through actual browser forms
Product WhatsApp link uses verified opted-in business phone
Browser product/cart/checkout creates persisted direct order with native amount
Order WhatsApp message has public reference and no buyer phone or handoff secret
Seller browser preparation and handoff persist without verified funds
Message XSS renders as text without executing
Seller sees persisted buyer messages after reconnect
Response-loss retry persists exactly one message
Completed direct browser checkout creates no ledger/wallet/transaction and reserves stock once
Chat layout has no horizontal overflow at 390
Chat layout has no horizontal overflow at 768
Chat layout has no horizontal overflow at 1440
